lines: We have a credible tip that the government is planning to cordon off large sections of the Northside district, marking them as Spoiled quarantine zones.
These places will be under heavy surveillance, and residents cannot exit the quarantine zone.
We estimate that the quarantine will take effect in the next 48 hours.
If you are a resident of Northside who is healthy and able, you have two days to find another place of residence before you will have your movements restricted by the government.
